text:
elaine: Heads up — just noticed a deploy swapped the service token scope for service/internal-ingest in prod. It appears the role binding included s3:PutObject on analytics-bucket by mistake.
deploy-bot: deploy svc/internal-ingest v2.7.1 -> prod succeeded (deploy/1934) :white_check_mark: 
mike: wtf when did that go out? which PR?
elaine: PR #4217 — the role refactor changed a grant from analytics:write to analytics:write+put-object. I only saw it in logs while investigating a spike in S3 writes.
jordan: Confirming — audit log shows principal service/internal-ingest-service-token assumed role ingest-service-role and performed s3:PutObject on analytics-bucket/* at 2026-03-20T03:45:12Z.
securitybot: audit-entry: {principal: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ingest-service-role/internal-ingest, action: s3:PutObject, resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-analytics-prod/*, requestId: abcd-1234} 
ops-oncall: Is this limited to prod analytics-bucket or other buckets too?
elaine: So far only analytics-bucket shows the writes. No sign of data exfil yet, writes look internal (small JSON blobs). Still bad — principle of least privilege violated.
mike: Immediate plan: 1) revoke the service token 2) attach temporary deny to ingest-service-role for s3:PutObject 3) rotate creds and rollback PR. Can someone run the deny policy?
jordan: I'll push a deny policy now. Command:
```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name ingest-service-role --policy-name temp-deny-s3-put --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-analytics-prod/*"}]}'
```
elaine: Doing token rotation now — creating new token, updating k8s secret, and restarting pods. ETA ~6m.
securitybot: rotation-started: secrets/k8s/ingest-service-token updated by elaine at 2026-03-20T03:53:07Z
mike: Good. Jordan, after deny is in place, can you search CloudTrail for any PutObject by this principal in last 7 days and list keys? We need to confirm no suspicious uploads.
jordan: On it. Quick grep shows 17 PutObject events in last 24h from that principal, mostly under prefix /ingest/events/*. I'll paste sample entries and requestIds to S3 team.
jordan: sample: requestId=abcd-1234 key=ingest/events/2026/03/20/0001.json size=2.1KB 
ops-oncall: S3 lifecycle / object-lock? Not set on analytics bucket. We should snapshot the bucket and add object-level logging.
elaine: Creating object-level tag "ir-investigate" and exporting object list. Also enabling block-public-access and verifying no public ACLs.
mike: We'll need a postmortem but first containment. After rotation succeed and deny confirmed, roll back PR & run CI check that prevents granting s3:PutObject in role refactor.
jordan: Adding a CI gate rule proposal: role-linter should flag any role that grants s3:PutObject on prod buckets unless annotated with approved_ticket. I'll file the ticket.
elaine: FYI, KMS key used to encrypt the bucket is customer-managed. I checked key policy — ingest-role had kms:GenerateDataKey for that key via a wildcard. We should tighten that too.
mike: Good catch. Add a tight condition for kms:ViaService or specific encryption context? Jordan, can you remove broad kms:GenerateDataKey from the role?
jordan: I'll add a conditional policy restricting kms:GenerateDataKey to resource-level and encryption context requiring aws:s3:arn match. Pushing change after deny.
securitybot: policy-change: put-role-policy temp-deny-s3-put succeeded at 2026-03-20T03:55:48Z
ops-oncall: Confirming deny in place — attempts to PutObject from the old token are now 403 AccessDenied in CloudTrail.
elaine: Rotation finished. New token deployed, pods restarted, no more PutObject attempts.
mike: Thanks. Next steps: 1) full CloudTrail export to sec-account 2) S3 object integrity check & snapshot 3) PR rollback and fix role refactor 4) CI lint rule + test 5) postmortem + customer notif if needed 6) audit KMS key policies. Assigning owners: CloudTrail export -> jordan, S3 snapshot -> ops-oncall, PR rollback -> elaine, CI rule -> mike, postmortem -> elaine/jordan.
jordan: Started export job to sec-account. ETA 12m.
ops-oncall: Snapshot job queued.
elaine: I'll open the postmortem draft and link logs.
mike: Great. After postmortem we need a regular audit of role changes in the last 30 days — look for any accidental privilege widenings.
securitybot: reminder: scheduled role-change report scheduled for 2026-03-20T08:00Z.
elaine: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in the postmortem thread. :thumbsup:
